about_the_game:
About the Demo

In the demo version of "Boba Cafe Simulator - Rebirth: My Manager Life in the Ice Castle Sweet City", experience the joy of making bubble tea with your friends! In this demo, you’ll be able to play through the opening portion of the game. Compared to the full version, the demo has limited features and progress. Progress and save data from the demo cannot be carried over to the full game.

The demo includes only a subset of the shop facilities—more machines will be available in the full version.

In the demo, there are only two bubble tea recipes for players to create, while the full game will have dozens of unique recipes to discover.
The demo has limited decorations, customer types, and sound effects; the full version will feature more variety in these areas.

Collaborative Management & Creative Division of Labor

Up to four players can team up online:
Focus on drink preparation at the bar—brewing tea, adding toppings, and shaking to perfection, where each step influences the flavor score.
Manage the front counter, dynamically set prices, upgrade equipment, and attract waiting customers through “promotional pop-ups.”
Freely design your shop’s style, from rustic wooden tables and chairs to neon signboards—every decoration combination boosts foot traffic.

Deep Strategy to Control the Business Lifeline

Faced with a dynamic market, you’ll decide:
Will you conquer the student crowd with low-priced bubble tea, or develop the “Aurora Special” to attract high-end tourists?
Every dollar earned can unlock new tools—refrigerators, ice makers, tea brewers, warmers, slicers, ice cream makers, shaved ice molds...

Absolute Freedom

Freely place machines and shelves—choose your favorite layout!

There are no “standard answers” to bubble tea recipes—foam thickness, ice crystal ratio, sweetness balance—trust your instincts!

Delivery Rush – Urban Jungle Law More Intense than Management

Unlock the delivery feature to gain more orders—send your friends out to deliver, or recruit little yellow and blue minions to help with deliveries!

Equip your bike with a heated tea box, or earn enough to unlock drones that can defy no-fly zones.

“Use the warmth of one cup of bubble tea to save this soon-to-collapse sweet universe!”

Now click [Start Your Shop Now] – Icebao’s tail has already spun into a propeller!

short_description: Reborn at my venture's start. Last life, poor management got my milk tea shop crushed by rivals. At the door, sweet milk scent hit me, fired me up. Now, "Frost Citadel" aims to haunt the milk tea world. With my friend, we’ll set up to rule this street.
